quotes.text: Whereas governance is kind of looking forward. Governance is kind of looking at, how can we prevent things from happening? I always tell clients, part of my job is to help keep you off the news.
quotes.speaker: Alan Cox
quotes.why: A crisp distinction between backward-looking compliance and forward-looking governance.

quotes.text: co-pilot doesn't necessarily introduce new risk. It can surface existing risk. So it can surface over-promissioning, over-sharing.
quotes.speaker: Alan Cox
quotes.why: States the core thesis that Copilot exposes existing permission problems rather than creating new ones.

quotes.text: the way I view it, no user, no two users are necessarily the same. No risks are the same and no day is the same.
quotes.speaker: Alan Cox
quotes.why: Explains the reasoning behind risk-based, adaptive DLP controls in plain words.

quotes.text: for any organization thinking about going to co-pilot, and launching any, either co-pilot or AI in their environment, the very first thing I would be doing is pulling a full sharing and permission report and see who has access to what.
quotes.speaker: Alan Cox
quotes.why: A concrete first step for Copilot readiness.

quotes.text: My summary when it comes to governance is make it easy for the user to do the right thing. Because if you make things too hard and too complicated and too many controls, they're going to go outside the confines of your boundary
quotes.speaker: Alan Cox
quotes.why: Summarizes the guest's governance philosophy and its link to shadow IT.

Compliance Manager, insider risk and communication compliance

takeaways: Copilot rarely creates new risk; it surfaces existing oversharing and over-permissioning, so start with a full sharing and permission report.
Combine auto-labeling with DLP policies, now creatable in DSPM for AI, to keep Copilot away from sensitive content down to the single site or document.
Use Insider Risk Management and adaptive protection to scale controls by user risk, and design governance that makes the right thing easy to avoid shadow IT.
hook: Rolling out Microsoft Copilot exposes every permission and sharing mistake already hidden in your Microsoft 365 tenant. Security, compliance and IT leads hear from MVP Alan Cox how Microsoft Purview, DLP, sensitivity labels, DSPM for AI and Insider Risk Management keep sensitive data out of AI responses without blocking productivity.
